name: World of Tanks: HEAT
description:
Experience World of Tanks in a whole new way with World of Tanks: HEAT. Rather than just being built around tanks, the 5v5 and 10v10 hero-driven PvP game asks players to choose from a roster of unique Agents with varying abilities to pilot upgradable tanks in combat. Between the two, players can create a playstyle that appeals to them.

As Wargaming built World of Tanks: HEAT, they also built a completely new engine to support it, creating a visual environment that allows players to feel every action. Improved combat visuals, particle effects, and VFX all enhance the experience.

World of Tanks: HEAT is a cross-platform game available on PC, Steam Deck, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and GeForce Now. It features both cross-platform play and progression.

name: Where Winds Meet
description:
Explore tenth-century China in Everstone Studio and NetEase Games’ open-world ARPG, Where Winds Meet. Featuring MMO elements, the game allows players to design their own character and take up the role of a young sword master (or mistress), exploring the nation following a personal disaster. Travel through the wilderness, villages, and cities. Meet a wide cast of characters. Uncover long-hidden secrets. The game features Wuxia-style combat, allowing players to combine melee, ranged, and stealth depending on the weapons they are using. Those weapons include swords, spears, rope darts, fans, umbrellas, and more. Players can also join different in-game factions to learn even more skills during their travels. Players can choose their difficulty, playstyle, and whether or not to go solo or team up with friends. There are hours of content before the player even leaves the first zone. In addition to combat, players can explore, solve puzzles, take part in leisurely activities, and more.

On the monetization front, Everstone went with a large collection of cosmetics – clothes, accessories, and other items that players can obtain through the shop or other means. Some of these items are available through gameplay.

name: Neverness to Everness
description:
Welcome to Hethereau, a city where humans live side by side with the supernatural, and individuals with special abilities known as “Espers” are tasked with dealing with anomalous threats. In Hotta Studio’s urban open-world action RPG, players take on the role of a special Esper, designated “Esper Zero,” who, in their role as the Appraiser at Eibon Antique Shop, helps hunt anomalies and deal with other problems in the city. Neverness to Everness is a gacha game that blends some GTA/Saint Row-style play with team-based combat and supernatural mysteries. The game is set in a city filled with plenty to explore. Simply walking to the corner store could be filled with danger, with anomalous activity happening frequently and plenty of characters to interact with. As players explore, they’ll be able to interact with friends on a regular basis, developing bonds and earning rewards for doing so.

In addition to their job as the Appraiser, players can engage in other activities, including working at various shops to earn money for cars, apartments, and more. As their friendships develop, they can invite characters to their home, take them on rides in their car, or simply hang out and go on dates. Other activities include fishing and racing. Just don’t get caught breaking the law, or you will spend time in jail. NTE also boasts multiplayer features. These include things like games of Mahjong at the local maid cafe. Or, if you’re looking for something more daring, how about a bank heist? It’s the kind of activity that demands friends.

name: Battlefield REDSEC
description:
Battlefield REDSEC is an independent, free-to-play battle royale mode for Battlefield 6. The game offers a new spin on the battle royale genre using Battlefield’s Dna, offering a massive and fast-paced experience featuring squad play. Players compete in teams with those that survive making their way into the knockout-style elimination mode, Gauntlet.

Battle takes place in Fort Lyndon, a blacksite set in Southern California. The military facility is set up between beaches and a residential community, offering players a variety of terrain to compete on. The terrain is destructible, allowing players to open pathways when needed or destroy enemy cover. When in the Gauntlet, players will race to complete missions as well as eliminate their foes. In addition, REDSEC offers players access to a sandbox area where they can build their own maps for free.

name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
description:
Get into the action in one of the longest running battle royale games PUBG Battlegrounds. Originally titled PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds, the game has been offering players the full battle royale experience in a more realistic setting since 2017. Test yourself against 99 other players on seven different maps using whatever weapons you can find. Just be sure to be the last one standing, because that’s the only way to win.

Go it alone or play with friends in groups of two or four. Start out with only the clothes on your back, loot buildings, towns, and other locations to obtain the equipment you need. This includes weapons, armor, vehicles, and more. If you want the really good gear – and it’s likely you do – you’ll have to take some risks and head to the more dangerous zones on the map.

As is generally the case with the battle royale formula, PUBG’s map shrinks over time, herding all players into a random location where they will eventually have no choice but to engage each other or risk taking damage outside the restricted area. At the same time, random areas of the map will be bombed. So, players must be aware of both events and do their best to avoid them.

PUBG Battlegrounds is free-to-play and offers players purchasable items in the form of cosmetics. These do not impact game play.

name: Roblox
description:
Roblox is a free to play sandbox MMO. Imagine MineCraft with the option to take your creations, add story and other gameplay elements, turn it into a game and then post it for others to experience it. 

There are even ways to earn money and create micro-transitions for other users to support your game-worlds if they enjoy them. That is Roblox for you in a nutshell. Since Roblox’s main appeal is the vast variety of games created by users, it will be near impossible to explain gameplay in Roblox, since it will be completely different depending on which world you are playing in. Along with the thousands of games you can play on Roblox, it also has a social platform to it. You can follow different content creators and even add users on your friend’s list and interact with them within the game.

There are many feature in place within the Roblox servers that are designed to keep children safe. All chat is moderated and parents can easily track their kid’s activity within the game. One of the major rules in Roblox is the no dating rule, which helps keep the focus on playing and building games instead of deep social interaction of questionable nature.The game development portion of Roblox is one of the strongest features it has to offer. 

With nearly unlimited possibilities, and its own programming language that is designed for teens to understand and learn, Roblox is an amazing engine for game programmers to hone their craft, along with making a couple bucks!

name: Marvel Rivals
description:
Play as your favorite Marvel characters in NetEase Games’ superhero team shooter Marvel Rivals. 

Choose from an impressive roster of superheroes and villains to build the ultimate team and engage in 6v6 battles. Each hero offers unique abilities that can be combined with others on the team. These combinations, known as “Team-Up Skills” can be used to create new tactics that may make the difference in a match.

Marvel Rivals features destructible environments, including places like Asgard and Tokyo circa 2099. Strategic players can take advantage of this, changing paths, creating cover, or even cornering the enemy. More features are added as time goes on, as is the ever-growing roster of playable characters.

name: Enlisted
description:
Get ready to command your own World War II military squad in Gaijin and Darkflow Software’s squad-based shooter Enlisted. Play as an infantry squad leader, tank crew, or even an aircraft pilot in a game where everything from the uniforms and weapons to the vehicles are designed with historical accuracy in mind.

In Enlisted, players can train an equip their squad with weapons and other useful items before taking them into battle. Players control one soldier in their squad at a time, and have the ability to switch when a part of the squad has been defeated. When one solider is under player control, the rest are controlled by AI that obeys player orders.

Players have access to four different campaigns, each associated with a specific real-world battle. In each instance the squads, weaponry, vehicles and more will appropriately correspond to each location and date. The game offers hundreds of realistic weapons as well as vehicles that World War II buffs will be familiar with. 

As for the squads, players have access to 12 different kinds of specialists. In addition to the soldiers that spawn naturally, players can recruit additional ones.

name: Overwatch
description:
The tale of the hero organization Overwatch continues in Overwatch 2. This new take on the popular team shooter changes up things a little with five-man teams, redefined classes, and new playable characters. With the adjustment to 5v5, players now have more individual impact than in the previous game.

Challenge yourself in all-new modes. Take control of a robot with your team in Push and take it to the enemy base before the enemy can take it from you. Explore all new areas, including iconic real-world cities such as New York, Rome, Monte Carlo, Toronto, and more.

Overwatch 2 features an update schedule that drops new content every nine weeks. It also boasts a regular battle pass – both free and premium. This is where some of the game’s characters will be obtained.

name: Gloria Victis
description:
Gamigo’s Gloria Victis is a free-to-play open-world medieval MMORPG that combines features from games like Mount & Blade and PlanetSide 2 with an atmosphere reminiscent of The Witcher. Take on a variety of roles: soldier, knight, assassin, huntsman, and more – or all of them – via the game’s class-less progression system. No need to choose, you can build the character you want and even have hundreds of items to choose from to customize your equipment.

Once the character is built, explore the open world and compete against other players for control of territories. Claim land and siege towns and castles. Build your own fortifications to defend against those who would attack you. Just be aware of where you’re traveling, because some areas of the map are riskier than others – although the rewards increase to match. In some of these areas, players will be able to choose the loot they want from defeated enemies, but only within a limited amount of time.

The game’s medieval low-fantasy setting will appeal to those players looking for something a bit more realistic. As players explore, they’ll come across forests, swamps, ruins, snowy mountaintops, and more. They’ll also uncover ancient secrets and dig up plenty of treasure.

name: Game Of Thrones Winter Is Coming
description:
Game of Thrones Winter is Coming is a free-to-play browser-based RTS based on the George R.R. Martin novels and popular HBO series. In the game developed by YOOZOOGames, player take on the role of a Westeros lord set on putting a stop to the wars between the Seven Kingdoms.

The game is built in Unity and offers players a balanced mix of strategy and RP. Players build bases, grow their kingdom, train armies, and recruit characters from the show, all while living within the story set forth in the TV series.

name: Genshin Impact
description:
If you’ve been looking for a game to scratch that open-world ARPG itch, one with perhaps a bit of Asian flair, then you’re going to want to check out miHoYo’s Genshin Impact. The developer, known previously for Honkai Impact 3rd, take players to the world of Teyvat, a vast open-world designed for extended exploration. Players not only explore dungeons, but climb mountains, trees, and buildings to discover all kinds of secrets. 

Of course, the main character doesn’t travel alone. Instead, players build a four-player group out of over 20 characters that can be swapped out to create the best group for any particular mission. The characters, each with different skills filling out the classic RPG types as well as distinct elemental focuses, can be obtained via gameplay or the game’s gacha mechanics – as is gear. Both characters and gear are upgraded in the game via the in depth crafting system.

In addition, the game offers players an adventurer system that provides them with even more to do, be it daily quests, small favors for the locals, or big continent-traveling quests. The adventurer system also rewards players for their activities with a wide variety of items.

Genshin Impact is available to players on PC, PlayStation 4, and mobile devices. It also features a multiplayer mode allowing up to four players to play together and cross-play across all four platforms, however, PlayStation 4 does not allow for cross-progression.

name: Dungeon Stalker
description:
OneUniverse combines RPG dungeon crawling with survival games in its PvEvP title, Dungeon Stalkers. Players take on the role of a Dungeon Stalker, choosing from a roster with their own unique stories, and explore dungeons to find treasure and experience the game’s story. As they progress, players will fight alongside companions and grow stronger. They’ll need to, as the dungeons they’re exploring are even more dangerous due to a witch’s curse.

Each Stalker has their own unique skills. During their dungeon runs, players will be able to acquire rare and legendary weapons to defeat both the monsters and other stalkers in the dungeon. Of course, the objective is to make it out alive and bring all that sweet loot with them. In order to make it out, players will also have to contend with the witch’s curses. Although perhaps they can turn them to their benefit.

Players need to keep in mind that armor is incredibly important in Dungeon Stalkers. Worn or destroyed armor makes everything even more dangerous. So, keep it maintained.

name: One Punch Man: World
description:
One Punch Man: World is a free-to-play multiplayer 3D action game from Crunchyroll Games. Players take on the role of characters from the popular anime including Saitama, Mumen, Silverfand, Rider, and Genos, and fight against some well-known villains.

Each character boasts their own fighting style and unique set of abilities, just like in the anime. In keeping with that, players can expect cinematic finishing moves. Challenge monsters with a friend via the Hero Association HQ hub. It’s more fun than doing it alone.

The game also offers players plenty of story to get invested in even allowing a peek at the characters’ daily lives, including more mundane things like shopping at the market.

Available on Android, iOS, and PC, One Punch Man: World also features cross-play and progression.

name: Crystal Saga Nova
description:
Crystal Saga Nova is a free-to-play browser-based MMORPG from R2Games. Featuring five playable classes, a guild system, PvP, system and more, the game offers players plenty to do. Explore the world, complete quests, level and train pets, and engage in PvP.

Play as one of five classes: Priest, Ranger, Rogue, Mage, and Knight, with plenty of options to make your character stronger over time. Aside from standard leveling and gear, the pets and mounts provide buffs. Pets can even aid in combat. Crystal Saga Nova also includes wings that look cool while offering players additional stats. Pets, mounts, and wings are all upgradable, offering even higher stats.

In addition to questing and leveling characters, the game offers players plenty of things to do, including dungeons, boss battles, and PvP. Players can earn XP via guild quests and even AFK grinding as well.

name: World of Sea Battle
description:
Grab your rum and hoist the sails in Thera Ineractive’s free-to-play MMORPG set during the Golden Age of sailing. Featuring dozens of historical ships – some filled with pirates – World of Sea Battle offers both PvE and PvP play as players take to the sea, captaining customizable historical ships such as schooners, brigantines, frigates, and more.

Players will engage in battle on the sea, fighting in both PvE and PvP naval battles and using a variety of artillery. When not fighting, they can explore the Endless Sea and work to accumulate enough gold to afford their own private island outpost, where they can mend ships and increase their fortune via mines and workshops. And they’ll want all the gold they can get, because that’s how everything is achieved in the game.

As for accumulating that gold, there are plenty of options ranging from raiding merchant ships to building trade empires, and more. To be truly successful in the game, it is suggested that players team up with friends. Guilds will be the best way to do that.

name: RF Online Next
description:
RF Online Next is a sci-fi PvP MMORPG set on the world of Novus, where humanity must fight against machines. Some members of humanity have evolved into beings known as Scions and can use Arcane relics and Biosuits in combat. The suits act as an artificial body and allow them to fly and swap abilities mid-combat as needed.

RF Online Next hosts faction battles that reward the winning teams with key resources and a share of taxes from the game’s market. The game also features a full storyline with various regions and dungeons for players to explore. Fight world bosses and take part in world and server-wide battles.

name: Soul's Remnant
description:
An indie game that spent a decade in development, Chaomoon’s Soul’s Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG featuring a classless skill system that allows players to build their characters from a library of more than 72 combat and life skills.

The game features pretty much everything players expect from an MMORPG, including a party system, guilds, and friends lists. New players will find a dedicated community that grew over the ten years of development already built in.

The game offers more than 200 maps for players to explore and plenty of quests to complete, monsters and bosses to fight, and more to keep them busy. This includes a crafting and gathering system with fishing, mining, and herbalism. Gear is craftable, and players have plenty to choose from, including hundreds of weapons.

name: Palia
description:
Enter the world of Palia, a cozy MMO from Singularity Six. Explore the world, uncover mysteries, and build your new home. Palia is filled with everything from fields and forests to beaches and mountains, and players can explore it all. Gather the necessary materials, set up your garden, craft the things you need, and build your home making it bigger as you progress.

Explore Palia not just for materials needed to craft and build, but also to solve the mysteries of the world, including what happened to the humans that lived there 1,000 years ago. Befriend the villagers, build relationships, and maybe even find a partner.

Palia is different from most MMOs in that it’s not combat-centric. The only weapons players have are those they will use for hunting. If you’re looking for something low-stress with adventure thrown in. This is it.

name: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
description:
The legacy of Phantasy Star Online 2 continues a thousand years later, as the next generation of ARKS operatives join forces with a race known as the Meteorn on the planet Halpha to defend against a new threat, The Dolls. Phantasy Star Online 2: New Genesis is an open world online RPG featuring a day-night cycles, weather effects, and a revamped battle system. It also introduces ways to travel no in the previous game, including gliding. All of this is built on a new graphics engine. 

Despite its differences from PSO2, the games are still connected, with players being able to move back and forth via the client. Players of the original can even bring characters already created in the original game, as well as certain items into New Genesis. For those who played the original game, New Genesis will be familiar in a lot of ways. The games have similar interfaces, quest types and other features. They both also share the same class types, and as with the original game, players will use Mags in combat. 

Players just entering the Phantasy Star Online 2 universe through New Genesis will also be able to take advantage of its relationship with the original game. The games share the same client and players can move between them and even collect gear from the original game to use in NGS.

name: My Hero Ultra Rumble
description:
My Hero Ultra Rumble is a free-to-play 24-player Battle Royale featuring characters from My Hero Academia. Take on the role of one of the many heroes and villains and team up with two other players to win the battle. The game’s roster is made up of five archetypes, including Rapid, Technical, Assault, Support, and Strike. Each character in those archetypes has its own unique Quirk, which can be synergized with the Quirks of the other two members of the team. Players can also make their teams and characters more powerful by collecting items and interacting with NPCs during combat.

As they play, players will be able to make their character more unique using customization earned through experience game and completing missions. Seasonal events also offer players exclusive customization items. Each of the game’s seasons will introduce new elements while adding new characters and costumes.

name: Brighter Shores
description:
A point-and-click style MMORPG from Andrew Gower, the creator of RuneScape. Brighter Shores offers players hundreds of hours of gameplay in a fantasy universe. 

Players begin their story as a new recruits in the Hopeport town guard where they find themselves forced to deal with problems caused by a harbor storm and local goblins. Discovering magic sources, players will become one of three classes: Cryoknight, Guardian, or Hammermage. They’ll need these powers to stop the corrupting forces in the Hopeforest.

In addition to the three classes, Brighter Shores has a long list of professions players can take on. These include fisher, chef, miner, merchant, blacksmith, and more. The game features plenty of story content and places to explore. That said, only Hopeport and Hopeforest are available for free. Players will need to purchase the Premium pass to access additional places. The pass also offers players a unique character name, exclusive offer dyes, and player-to-player trading.

name: Honkai: Star Rail
description:
Join the ranks of the Nameless and step aboard the Astral Express to follow the path the Aeon Akivili once tread. HoYoVerse’s Honkai: Star Rail begins on a space station where the main character, known as the Trailblazer, is woken during an invasion. Missing they’re memory, the Trailblazer is invited to join the crew of the Astral Express, where they may search for answers as they traverse different worlds.

Each world is associated with a different god-like entity, or Aeon, and as the Trailblazer visits each world, they acquire new abilities related to that Aeon. This typically aids them in dealing with disasters caused by objects called “Stellarons”, also known as the Cancer of All Worlds.

The Trailblazer carries one of these Stellarons inside themselves, and as they travel, they endeavor to learn more about it and solve the mystery of their missing past.

As Honkai: Star Rail is a gacha game, players can roll on many of the characters they meet throughout their travels. As with Star Rail’s sister game Genshin Impact, these characters boast elemental abilities of varying types, each related to one of the game’s Aeons. Weapons and other power-up items are rolled on as well.

Honkai: Star Rail’s gameplay includes repeatable fights required to obtain leveling materials as well as mini-games and regular events.

name: Lost Ark
description:
Smilegate’s free-to-play multiplayer ARPG is a massive adventure filled with lands waiting to be explored, people waiting to be met, and an ancient evil waiting to be destroyed. In Lost Ark, players enter the world of Arkesia and embark on a journey across several lands in a quest to locate the Ark of Legends. Stop the demon Kazeros and his army before they seize control. And hurry, the demons are searching for the Ark too.

Choose to play as one of several classes ranging from the sword-wielding warrior to a mage or even the gunner – each with several advanced class options. Play alone or with friends (or acquaintances) to explore seven vast continents filled with strange cultures and creatures. Fight in PvP, explore dungeons, and work together in raids. Decide what you like to do best and go for it – but don’t forget to save the world.

Lost Ark offers an easy-to-learn system with plenty of room to customize. Use the game’s ‘Tripod’ system to unlock up to three tiers of customization for each ability and create the combat style that works best for you.

As for other features, Lost Ark offers crafting, guilds, and other systems players expect from online games. Whatever you want to do, it’s up to you.

name: Diablo Immortal
description:
The demon fighting doesn’t have to stop when you walk away from the computer thanks to Blizzard Entertainment’s Diablo Immortal. Built for mobile and also released on PC, the game fills in the gaps between Diablo II and III in an MMOARPG environment.

Diablo Immortal picks up following the presumed death of the Archangel Tyrael, during which time mankind must deal with the fallout. One of the many problems are the fragments of the shattered Worldstone spread across the land, waiting for Diablo’s underlings to collect them in an attempt to bring about his return.

Players can choose from one of six classes in Diablo Immortal. These are the classic Barbarian, the Crusader, the Demon Hunter, the Monk, the Necromancer, and the Wizard. All six classes features their own unique skills and abilities.

The game also introduces six new bosses, ranging from The Skeleton King to the Glacial Colossus. Each offers players a unique challenge, and all are found in places filled with danger. So, players will want to be well prepared before taking them on.

name: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra
description:
Billed as the “first team-oriented free-to-play game” made using the Dragon Ball IP, Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra allows players to build teams from all their favorite Z Warriors and their enemies (or in many cases, frienemies) to compete in 4v4 battles. The cross-platform MOBA features top-down gameplay in three different modes: Standard Battle, Land Grab, and Finders Keepers.

Standard Battle has players eliminating the Gods of Destruction in order to claim the Dragon Ball. This mode features a “Divine Draw” at the beginning that applies two special rules to the match, affecting battle. During battle, players also make use of “Divine Combo Cards” to apply perks to their characters.

Land Grab requires players to capture and hold three points in order to generate points. The match ends when one team earns 500 points. And in Finders Keepers, teams are designated either attack or defense. The attack team works to locate hidden treasure while the defending team tries to keep them from locating it.

Similar to most MOBAs, Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra divides characters into three roles: Damage, Tank, and Technical. Technical provides support. As players progress, in each round, they can upgrade their character, unlocking new attacks and abilities.
Players can also make the characters their own, customizing them with skins, animation enhancements, and more.

name: Ragnarok: The New World
description:
Ragnarok Online players looking for an open-world experience only need to look at Ragnarok: The New World. The latest entry in the franchise is cross-platform and offer players a grind-free experience with the ability to master every class on one character and design builds to their taste. Stats can be reset for free. Gear can be refined without breaking it. Resources can be obtained while offline.

The game introduces the Druid class, featuring three different forms: Werewolf, Wereraptor, and Human Arcanist. Players can swap between these at will.

The MMORPG offers players the standard social features like the ability to party with others. It also features a wedding system and the ability to haggle when selling via the auction house. Characters are customizable, with a wide variety of dye and hair options. Players can also obtain special MVP mounts by defeating them in the wild.

name: Valorant
description:
Test your mettle in Riot Games’ character-based FPS shooter Valorant. Boasting over 10 Agents (the game’s characters) and several map options, Valorant pits players against each other in 5v5 matchups. Players won’t just use guns but also special, sometimes paranormal, abilities. Agents come from all around t he world, each bringing something unique to one of the four classes. Each has four abilities – some gun-oriented, and others tied to their unique skills.

The game’s maps range from the desert-like split map, to a monastery, to a city, and finally an old European town. Some of the maps are focused on destruction, while others feature verticality or are dedicated to gameplay like site control.

Players also have a rather large arsenal of weapons to work with ranging from a knife to pistols, shotguns, automatic weapons, and the like.

name: Aero Tales Online
description:
Aero Tales Online: The World is a free-to-play 3D anime-style MMORPG with PvP and PvE elements. The game revolves around the “mysterious story of the Key of Skylight” – sending players on an adventure they’ll have to experience on their own. There’s not much in the way of details on the game’s story. Hence the “mysterious” part.

To explore the world, players will need to be ready to fight. The good news is, it’s up to them how they do it. Players can choose between action-combat mode or tab-target mode during combat. They may also vary their playstyle with different combo combinations. A special combat style exists for each class, along with special items. Of course, players will need to choose their faction before beginning to rumble.

In addition to general exploration, the game offers flight once players reach a certain level. It also features daily events, and plenty of social activities. These include house building, farming, and marriage, among other things.

name: Arknights: Endfield
description:
Arknights: Endfield is a free-to-play RTS RPG with gacha elements. The game features an anime style and is set in the Arknights universe. Players take on the role of a character known as the “Endminstrator” of Endfield Industries, an organization tasked with defending humanity and expanding their presence on the mostly-untamed planet of Talos-II.

Endministrators achieve their goals by leading teams of operators made up of powerful individuals. These operators are obtained via the game’s gacha system.

In addition to the usual combat seen in gacha RPGs, Arknights: Endfield also features a factory management system that players will use to expand their reach on Talos-II, helping tame the wilds outside of the established Civilization band. Players also use elements of factory construction to solve puzzles and explore the game’s world.

name: Halo Infinite
description:
For the first time ever, a free-to-play Halo experience is available in the form of Halo Infinite’s multiplayer. 343 Industries and Xbox Game Studios made the multiplayer version of the game available separately from the full story campaign, which is available to purchase for $60 to allow everyone to get in on the action. With the multiplayer, players can take part in two different modes: Arena and Big Team Battle. The first returns to Halo’s multiplayer roots with on-map equipment and 4-player squads. Big Team Battle allows players to mix and match weapons, vehicles and equipment to create a unique combat experience.

The game also offers players the ability to customize their Spartan with cosmetic items. Of course, those with the campaign will have access to extra options. Even more can be found in the game’s battle pass which also introduces new modes and maps, as well as community-focused content.

name: Wuthering Waves
description:
Set in the post-apocalyptic world of Solaris-3, Wuthering Waves is an open-world action RPG with gacha elements developed and published by Kuro Games. Players take on the role of Rover, a character returning to a world recovering from a disaster known as the Lament. Despite obviously being part of this world, Rover has no memory of their past. But they do have an unusual ability, and some people seem to have some idea of who they are. Along the way, Rover meets different Resonators, individuals with varying powers who help them on their journey. These same Resonators are acquired through the game’s gacha system along with their weapons.

The game offers a rotating action-combat system with players swapping between three different Resonators in teams that they’ve built. Players will explore the world of Solaris, fighting monsters, solving puzzles, and completing quests and trials, among other things. The game is updated on an approximately six-week schedule. So there’s almost always something to do.

name: skate.
description:
Grab your board and head to the streets, rooftops, and anywhere else in San Vansterdam you think would make for a good place to show off your skills in Full Circle’s “skate.”. The cross-platform multiplayer game is the latest in the Skate franchise, offering players an experience with online PvP and co-op features.

It has everything you’d expect from a skateboarding game, such as physics-based stunts, while also including online social features and the ability to explore the game’s world without having to be on the board. When skating, players have access to improved Flick-It controls and are able to take on challenges and earn rewards. When they’d rather chill, they can hop off the board and explore the city, skating with friends in co-op challenges or competing against them. Progress is tracked across platforms, so they always have access to rewards.

If they’re feeling creative, they can build new spots to skate using Quick Drop items – and then challenge their friends. Or, they can hang out in one of the city’s parks. with friends in co-op challenges or compete against them. Progress is tracked across platforms, so they always have access to rewards.

As for the rewards, player characters are customizable, and players can earn all kinds of goodies to make their character their own, including hats, footwear, and accessories from big brands in skateboarding and street fashion.

name: Blade & Soul Heroes
description:
What led to the world we know from Blade & Soul? Now, players can find out by playing NCSoft’s free-to-play collectible action MMORPG, Blade & Soul Heroes. They’ll experience the world through the eyes of Yusol following the destruction of her clan as she tracks down those responsible and tries to rebuild. Along the way, players will meet many new characters, including younger versions of familiar faces.

Blade & Soul Heroes uses a dual combat system that allows players to switch between turn-based and real-time combat. During turn-based combat, all five characters on the player's team will be present on the battlefield. When players switch to real-time combat, a single hero will be used in fights with the other four characters supporting them. Players have more than 40 Heroes to build their team from.

name: Return Alive
description:
A free-to-play, top-down tactical shooter game, Return Alive casts players in the role of a survivor in an apocalyptic world where they must fight for resources, technology, and energy in the wilderness. 

The game offers players a variety of modes including battlegrounds and matches among others. In each mode, players will collect weapons and items, enhancing stats as they go along. They’ll also collect a Battlesuit that changes their appearance in addition to improving their stats.

Return Alive allows players to select their own skill effects as they progress. This, combined with equipment options allows players to customize their playstyle. The game’s matchmaking is designed so that players should expect to be paired with opponents equal to or slightly higher than their own skill level.

name: Fangs
description:
Fangs is a 4v4 MOBA with a customizable experience developed and published by Hidden Leaf Games. Players can unlock and alternate hero-specific augments to make their hero their own. The game boasts a diverse cast of characters, both in background and style. The developer’s intention is for players to really find a hero that resonates with them.

The game’s customization system allows players to change augments for each round, assuring that their own personal style can complement that of their teammates. Augments offer players the chance to boost abilities – a little more healing here, a little more damage there.

Fangs is designed to be fast-paced, cutting out a lot of the stuff that causes other MOBA matches to drag out. It focuses on teamwork with the ultimate goal being that players feel like part of a community. The game is also intended to be friendly to new players and veterans and is described as “easy to learn and hard to master”.

name: Delta Force
description:
The Delta Force series returns as a free-to-play modern tactical shooter from Team Jade. The game features different play modes, including one based on the 2002 movie Black Hawk Down. The other modes consist of a 32v32 PvP mode named Warfare and an Operations mode that sends players behind enemy lines.

The Black Hawk Down mode is a recreation of the mode from Delta Force: Black Hawk Down. It retells events from Mogadishu in Unreal Engine 5 and features non-stop action and drama.

Warfare offers players 32v32 player PvP across five different maps. The mode includes dozens of weapons, and various gameplay modes, and is updated regularly. Gameplay takes place on land and via land and sea, and players can take on a variety of roles.

In Operations, players team up in 3-person squads to take on AI-controlled mercenari9es, bosses, and other players. The game offers players a highly customizable armory, allowing the modification of weapons as well as vehicles.

name: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
description:
Explore the vast anime open-world of Magna with your friends in Shanghai Bokura Network Technology’s MMORPG Blue Protocol: Star Resonance. Create your own character using the game’s robust customization and go even further with your choice of outfits and styles. Choose any fighting style. Don’t worry about getting stuck, as you can swap at any time.

It’s an MMORPG, so get out there and make friends you can rely on when fighting the big bosses. Form or join a guild. Take part in social activities like dances and watching fireworks. Explore the world together and take part in raids.

The game offers players a selection of casual content as well as combat content, so everyone should be able to find something they enjoy doing.

name: Gundam Evolution
description:
Embrace your love of shooter and all thing Gundam, because Bandai Namco's Gundam Evolution is here for you. Gundam fans everywhere get to live out their dreams of hopping into a Gundam suit and taking on the enemy in this 6v6 game featuring Units from across the different Gundam universes. Each suit has its own set of skills and abilities, as well as HP levels – because some are just beefier than others.

In addition to their unique stats, the Units all feature a Thrust system that allows them to cover long distances quickly and a Dash ability for an additional acceleration boost. They also offer players access to G-Maneuver effects. These are unique to each Unit and can be activated with the G-Maneuver Meter hits 100%.

Gundam Evolution is currently available for free on Steam. It boasts a very positive rating on the platform, so Gundam fans will want to give it a peek.

name: Flyff Universe
description:
Players can now get the full Flyff experience on any platform with the browser-based Flyff Universe. The cross-platform game from Gala Lab allows players to access the world of Madrigal from anywhere, whether it be PC, phone, or tablet. As long as it has a browser, players are good to go.

Flyff Universe is an enhanced version of the original free-to-play MMORPG, featuring a new graphics engine with antialiasing, post-processing, advanced shaders, and more. The game also offers new quality of life changes with the developers monitoring things to make sure everything is operating as it should. But it hasn’t all changed, a lot of old school elements still exist in Flyff Universe, including PK, catchers, and gold icons.

The game offers players plenty of places to explore. Among these are the peaceful village of Flaris, the despair filled Mars Dungeon, Saint Morning – the home of Sain City, and the Iblis Temple.

name: Strinova
description:
Developed and published by iDreamSky, Strinova is a third-person tactical shooter that features the unique mechanic of allowing players to switch between three-dimensional and two-dimensional forms. This mechanic makes for interesting gameplay by allowing players to move through spaces they otherwise would not be able to – like paper sliding between cracks.

The game makes use of this mechanic with multilayered maps featuring a variety of game modes, including Demolition and Team Deathmatch. As for appearance, the developers smartly used an anime style, meaning characters look good in two or three dimensions. So players don’t have to worry about their character looking weird while sliding between gaps in walls.

name: Omega Strikers
description:
Grab two of your closest friends and team up in epic 3v3 soccer-style matches in Odyssey Interactive's Omega Strikers. The co-op PvP game pits two teams of three against each other in fast-paced matches where they both try to knock out their opponents and score goals soccer-style.

Similar to MOBAs and shooters, Omega Strikers features a growing roster of playable characters, including a well-armored hamster. Each character can be unlocked through gameplay and players have several play options to choose from. These include unranked, ranked, and private lobbies. The game also launched with a selection of maps. More maps and modes are planned for later release.

The game offers cosmetics and battle passes for monetization. There are no loot boxes or purchasable power boosts. The game will also feature seasons that will add new playable characters, stages, unlockables, and more.

name: Eden Eternal
description:
Eden Eternal is a free to play anime-style 3D MMORPG developed by X-Legend. Adventure towards the perfect land of Eden Eternal with your unique classes and along the way join a guild and start building towns with tons of customization options.

You were born from crystals and you are meant to lead your ravaged world to the land of Eden Eternal. Along the way you choose from multiple different classes that you can level up and if you start getting bored with one class just switch to another one and continue the leveling process. There are 20 different playable classes and 5 different races to choose from as you adventure through Eden Eternal.

If you are looking for a game with personal customization, then Eden Eternal has a few things for you. Purchase a house and upgrade various things inside of it, interior design, storage locations, ect. Then once you have a house and if you want even more customization join a guild. Guilds have access to entire towns that they can build with tons of different buildings to help you progress along your journey.

name: Raven2
description:
Raven2 is a free-to-play open-world MMORPG developed and published by Netmarble. Described as a “brutal dark fantasy” the game features classes that fit well with the environment, such as Assassin, Night Ranger, Destroyer, and Deathbringer, among others. Players can customize their characters using a customization system that caters to their visual tastes and style.

In the game’s story, players take on the role of a member of a Special Corps bearing what’s known as a “Cursed Stigma”. They’ll investigate strange phenomena taking place across the world, vanquishing demons and uncovering the world’s secrets.

In addition to the story content, the game offers large scale PvP. This is in the form of guild battles.

name: Fall Guys
description:
Play the most competitive massively multiplayer party royale game featuring beans ever for free on a variety of platforms. Mediatonic’s obstacle course-style game Fall Guys offers players all the excitement of being in a Japanese-style game show – only as a bean and with less chance of severe injury.

Make your way through the obstacle course as quickly as possible while avoiding all the dangers, and everyone else who’d like to take you out and take your spot at the top. Make the run by yourself or work together in teams… until you don’t need your friends any more, that is. Run across spinning tubes with holes in them. Dodge big blades and big balls. Break your way through doors.
 And do it all in style, with your choice of bean-shaped costumes.

Players can join their friends across several platforms including PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (via the Epic Games Store).

name: Spectre Divide
description:
Spectre Divide is a 3v3 tactical shooter developed and published by Mountaintop Studios in partnership with former pro gamer shroud, The game introduces a “Duality” mechanic that allows players to control two bodies on the map – a main body and a second body called a “Spectre”. The latter can be placed where the player feels they will be most useful. Then they can swap between the two bodies on the fly. This will allow the player to achieve more in the game, covering two sites at once.

With shroud’s input, Mountaintop has been able to fine-tune the game and make it ideal for competitive play. The game features “true-to-crosshair accuracy that allows players to shoot on the move. Twenty different weapons can be combined to customize gameplay to the trailer, and eight Sponsor kits offer unique load-outs to appeal to various playstyles.

Players can rank up as a team or on their own or take part in casual and custom play. In addition to the normal 3v3 matches, the game also includes a weekly “Crews” mode that pits teams of fifty to sixty players against each other.

name: Crystal Of Atlan
description:
Explore a magicpunk work in Nuverse’s MMO action RPG, Crystal of Atlan. The game takes players on a journey through a world that combines magic and technology as they explore dungeons, fight bosses, challenge other players, and help out where they can.

Players will start as one of five classes and quickly branch out into a selection of classes, creating a total of over a dozen classes in the game. Each class offers its own style to the game’s combat, taking advantage of the ability to execute in-air moves.

In addition to ongoing story content, Crystal of Atlan also offers PvP in both 3v3 and 1v1 modes that take advantage of the game’s combat system. Players can also participate in team battles in various multiplayer events such as co-op dungeons and the fleet system.

name: Steel Hunters
description:
In a post-apocalyptic world, mechanical giants known as Hunters are used to fight for resources on an abandoned Earth. In Wargaming’s extraction shooter Steel Hunters, players play as one of these hunters, each with its own playstyle, weapons, gear, and mods. Each also has its own unique progression system. As players perfect playing as their Hunter of choice, they can find ways to use their skills in conjunction with their teammates.

During gameplay, players collect boosters to gain an advantage over their opponents. In addition, the game offers players a full giant mech feel by allowing them to smash through buildings and other structures. It’s probably a good thing no one is still living on Earth. Players will also have to contend with the game’s AI in PvE encounters as they try to make their way to the extraction point.

name: Reign of Guilds
description:
Reign of Guilds is an open-world MMORPG inspired by old-school games like Ultima Online and EverQuest. Players start out by choosing one of fourteen professions and then create their own build using a wide selection of skills, spells, and equipment. They can then further define their build using buffs and items.

Once in the world, players will find that their actions have an impact. If they trade with NPCs, it will affect their prices. Killing mobs has an impact on the population. Even completing quests will have an impact. And since this is an MMO, each player will feel the effects of other players' actions.

The game offers a robust crafting and gathering system and a related market. For players who’d rather not deal with the market, there’s also the possibility of finding items they need by seeking out hidden merchants, abandoned homesteads, and the like.

The game world is broken up into zones with different danger levels. Green zones are safe. Yellow Zones are neutral, and killing others will cost karma. Karma lost becomes experience and items lost upon death. Black zones are dangerous areas where players are fighting for resources, and as a result, the karma isn’t impacted. But experience and items are lost upon death anyway. Finally, Red Zones are war areas, so death is to be expected but not punished.

name: Tower of Fantasy
description:
Tower of Fantasy is a 3D open-world RPG, anime-style sci-fi MMO RPG game with unique characters and beautiful open vistas!

Pack your gear and head to the lush planet of Aida, mankind’s last bastion after depleting Earth’s resources to near-inhabitability. In addition to be a viable world, Aida is also located near the path of the comet Mara, which contains an energy known as “Omnium”. To capture this energy, the people built the tower of Omnium, an act that resulted in a catastrophic disaster.

In Tower of Fantasy, players will explore the post-catastrophy world of Aida, taking in an open world filled with stunning nature and impressive structures. Play as a selection of characters, each armed with their own unique weapons, and take on the world with your friends. Take the time to learn about your characters, because you’ll need to know who can do what in order to build the best parties and defeat your enemies.

name: Waven
description:
Waven is a free-to-play co-op game from Wakfu developer Ankama. The game puts players in the role of a seafaring adventurer in a world made of of a few islands that survived a massive flood. Players explore a world that is still home to magic, but seems to have been abandoned by the gods and dragons that once resided there.

Players choose their hero, equip their spells and set out into the world. They’ll move between islands, fighting creatures and increasing their power. Fight in turn-based combat with friends or alone. Challenge yourself in PvP or PvE.

Wave is a cross-platform game. This means players can hop from one device to another.

name: Summoners War: Chronicles
description:
Help the King of Rahil defend his kingdom against a massive conspiracy set in the Summoners War Universe. In Summoners War: Chronicles, players become a Rahil Guard and explore the world with a summoned companion. The ARPG offers players a look at what decision led to the world as seen in the original Summoners War game, Sky Arena. Players can choose to play one of three Summoners: Orbia, Kina, and Cleaf. They, along with their summoned companion will explore the continents and fight the darkness.

Each of the three summoners has its own unique role and skill set. These roles are enhanced by the ability to summon a team of monsters. And there are plenty to choose from – more than 350. Players will need to manage both their own combat and that of the monsters in real time in order to successfully explore the world.

Summoners War: Chronicles can be played on mobile devices and PC.

name: Super Squad
description:
Prepare yourself. It’s time for Mayhem. And you’ll get that from Bad Fox Studios’ Super Squad, a multi-player online shoot-’em-up (or MOSH). It combines the playstyle of MOBA’s with the tactics of RTSs.

The game features a wide roster of characters including soldiers, goat men, angels, vikings, pirates, dogs, and even something called a “Florp”. The characters fill basic team roles – damage, support, etc, so players will need to choose wisely in order to build the best team and destroy the competition. Also take into account the various combat styles of each character, and their preferred weapons. These abilities range from being able to burrow under enemies and blow them up with landmines to grappling  your way around the map and picking your foes off from a distance.

Battle your way across a military base. Fight on Mars. Or even take down a mothership. There are several maps to choose from, with more on the way.

name: Superball
description:
Compete in fast-paced 3v3 football matches of a different kind in Pathea Games’ free-to-play competitive sports game Superball. Choose from a variety of heroes, each with their own unique abilities. Work together as a team filling the role of goalkeeper, midfielder, or forward in matches that take approximately five minutes to complete while enjoying the cyberpunk feel of the game’s arenas.

To win, players will need to work together to combine their characters’ unique abilities to execute the best moves. They’ll want to be careful, though, as each character has their own weaknesses as well.

As players level up, they’ll improve their equipment and earn accessories, allowing them to show off their own style while playing.

name: Microvolts: Recharged
description:
Microvolts: Recharged is a free-to-play lobby-based third-person shooter developed and published by Masangsoft. The game features several toy-themed arenas. The arenas range from a small town to a back yard requiring players to climb tables and maneuver around tea cups.

Players can choose from a range of anime-style characters but aren’t limited to a specific weapon for each. Instead, players will be able to swap between seven different weapon types. These include melee, rifle, shotgun, sniper, Gatling, bazooka, and grenade.

The game also allows players to customize their characters using a combination of ten costume parts. Players can collect mission costumes by unlocking achievements and completing missions.

name: Call of Duty: Warzone
description:
Call of Duty: Warzone is both a standalone free-to-play battle royale and modes accessible via Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. Warzone features two modes — the general 150-player battle royle, and “Plunder”. The latter mode is described as a “race to deposit the most Cash”. In both modes players can both earn and loot cash to be used when purchasing in-match equipment, field upgrades, and more. Both cash and XP are earned in a variety of ways, including completing contracts.

An interesting feature of the game is one that allows players who have been killed in a match to rejoin it by winning a 1v1 match against other felled players in the Gulag.

Of course, being a battle royale, the game does offer a battle pass. The pass offers players new weapons, playable characters, Call of Duty points, blueprints, and more. Players can also earn plenty of new items by completing objectives offered with the pass.

name: Throne And Liberty
description:
Throne and Liberty is a free-to-play multi-platform MMORPG from NCSoft and Amazon Games. The open-world game features large-scale PvPvE in which players can explore everything from sprawling plains to mountain peaks.

To survive, players will need to be able to adapt and make decisions based on weather, time of day, and – of course – what other players are doing. The ultimate goal is to claim the throne by defeating Kazar. To do this, players will need to make use of the ability to transform and take the battle to not just the land, but also the sea and air.

The game features cross-play bringing together players on PC, Xbox Series X}S, and PlayStation 5. Players on the PS5 can choose to disable cross-play. It’s also worth noting that cross-progression is not supported.

name: Veiled Experts
description:
Veiled Experts is a free-to-play multiplayer shooter game focused on the search-and-destroy mode of classic shooters. 

It combines newer gameplay – such as the shrinking map of battle royales with the classic mode to offer players a bit more. This means that it will be more difficult for players to camp each other and they’ll need to move around quite a bit. Luckily, the gameplay is vertical as well and players can navigate the world parkour-style.

Players can choose from a variety of unique players in order to find something that fits their playstyle. Based on the agent they choose, players can be support, full assault, do recon, snipe from far away, or just roll in for close-quarter combat. 

The game also features a changing landscape with buildings hit by bombs crumbling or ships sinking. This means players can eliminate things that might otherwise block their line of sight. That’s gonna make the whole hiding behind – or on – a wall thing that much more difficult.

name: Warborne Above Ashes
description:
Developed and published by Qooland, Warborne Above Ashes is a free-to-play full-time PvP MMO that allows players to jump in at any time and get their competitive fix in a wide range of combat. The game promises that players will always find someone to battle with, whether it be 1v1 matches or 100v100 group battles. Players can take part in cross-faction territory battles and find opportunities for combat in the form of solo combat, revenge missions, and multi-faction melee.

As the game doesn’t rely on linear quests, classes, or other methods of standard progression, players can easily hop into the game and get going. Character creation takes only about 30 minutes, and then players can join the fights anywhere.

To aid in their fights, players can recruit more than 40 Drifters and combine over 100 gear pieces using 12 different sets. Players can also choose their own vehicles and other useful items to create their own playstyle. Players also have access to a cross-server trading hub and can easily trade the items and accumulate wealth.

name: Deceit 2
description:
The Deceit franchise continues with Deceit 2. The social deduction horror game from World Makers casts players in various roles, some of which must be rooted out if the others want to survive.

Unlike a lot of social deduction games, Deceit 2 has four roles in the game. The Innocents are exactly what they sound like. Their goal is to avoid death at the hands of others while completing tasks that will help them find an escape key. The next role is the Infected. These individuals can transform and will execute the Innocent given the chance. To do this effectively, they’ll need to earn the trust of the team and wait for the opportune moment.

Another faction is the Cursed. They will work to sow chaos while deceiving Innocents and Infected alike. Finally, there’s the Master. Players will need to climb through the ranks to become a Master, unlocking new items that can help them escape while unleashing new Mutations to give them an edge.

name: Project Apidom
description:
Fight to make it out alive in Breach.gg and RedTigerPro’s apocalyptic extraction RPG, Project Apidom. Set in the future, the game drops players onto the world of Pangea, where they will team up with friends to fight both monsters and other players.

Pangea was once filled with scientists, but they now reside in the Breach where they create robots to contain their consciousness designed to fight the monsters that forced them to flee in the first place. The robots are fast but not equipped for a fight going in. Players will need to gather resources and craft items in order to fix that. Craft weapons and armor to unlock abilities and enhance the Apidom. As there are no pre-determined roles in the game, this is how players will dictate what their role is. Just be sure to keep an eye out for the enemies if you want to make it out alive.

Project Apidom is free-to-play and can be downloaded via Steam or the Epic Games Store.

name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
description:
Arena Breakout: Infinite is a free-to-play tactical extraction shooter from developer/publisher MoreFun Studios. 

The game features five maps: the Farm, the Valley, the Norhrides, the Armory, and the TV Station. Each requires players to adjust their strategy in order to be successful. Players can compete in a variety of modes, including Tactical Ops, Solo Ops, Covert Ops, and 4v4 Deathmatch.

The game features over 900 weapon mods and more than 20 attachment slots, allowing players to create their own custom weapons. As complicated as that might seem, the game also offers one-tap loadouts for new players that will allow them to gear up quickly. Players each have their own trophy room in the game. It’s described as an “off-field stronghold”. There, players can keep their spoils and collection of weapons and showcase them.

name: Vigor
description:
Vigor is available on PC (via Steam) and consoles. Developed and published by Bohemia Interactive, the game is set in the Outlands – all that’s left of a post-apocalyptic Norway in the early 90s.

The game features several modes: Encounters, Shootout, and Elimination. The former is a high-stakes mode where players will need to extract resources to build and upgrade their shelter while avoiding death. Shootout is a deathmatch where players are on their own. Elimination is a 5v5 round-based team fight.

In Vigor, players can make their Outlanders uniquely theirs with a variety of cosmetic sets ranging from military to non-military. In addition, shelters are more than just something players throw up quickly during Encounters. Permanent shelters also exist outside the mode. These can be upgraded and are where players will craft, generate currency, and more.

name: FragPunk
description:
A free-to-play 5v5 hero shooter, FragPunk uses items known as Shard Cards to modify the rules of matches. Players collect more than 100 different cards, which can be activated in different combinations, changing things up each round. These cards can have personal effects such as increasing jump height, altering ammunition, or having a broader impact, altering things for your or the enemy team. Some may even be used to resurrect.

To come out on top in FragPunk, players will need to be quick. Each round is only about two-and-a-half minutes. With 12 heroes to choose from, 17 customizable weapons, and a selection of cards, players have plenty of ways to find a playstyle that allows them to take down their enemies quickly.

Play across a collection of vibrant maps featuring a blend of realistic and stylized textures. Each map boasts its own vibe, with visuals made up of collages and graffiti. The game’s visual style is designed to be sharp and dynamic, offering players exciting environments in which to play.

name: Heartopia
description:
Heartopia is a life simulation game created by XD featuring online play. Players create a character and move into a small town that can host up to 12 players, each with their own customizable land and houses. Players help out each other and the local citizens of the town, engage in fun activities, and uncover the mysteries behind the town and the island it’s on.

Players pick up hobbies: gardening, cooking, fishing, pet raising, and more, all of which help in building the ultimate home. Players have a lot of options for creating their dream home, expanding their property, and designing the interior and exterior to their liking. Players can even ask their friends in-game to help them build their dream house.

Dress up your characters with a variety of outfits obtained via the town store or the game’s gacha system. Adopt cute animals. Go fishing, explore, and play mini games. Players can even throw parties and invite their friends.

name: Ravendawn
description:
Ravendawn is a 2D top-down MMORPG featuring homesteading and building mechanics. The game is designed to allow players to build anywhere and almost anything. Players claim a plot of land and gather resources in order to establish territory and build their homes.

The game boasts three primary archetypes that can be further refined by unlocking classes and skills. The base archetypes are Dark Knight, Bard, and Loremaster. Each has three skill trees to pull from, allowing players to create a class all their own.

As a game built around building your own place in the world, Ravendawn has a player-driven economy built around fishing, crafting, gathering, and more. Players can build out trade routes and shipping.

Players building their own homes and towns also means that the world will change with them and things will vary as time goes on.

name: The First Descendant
description:
The First Descendant is a free-to-play third-person 4-player co-op looter-shooter developed and published by Nexon. Featuring a variety of characters and equipment, the game is designed with excitement in mind. Each character has unique skill sets. They can also make use of grappling hooks in combat and can combine their skills with unique weapons to create their own battle style.

Each character has access to 3 guns, 4 secondary accessories, and a selection of sub-weapons. There are also items used to enhance player characters or their gear.

Play scenarios or world missions in order to level. Work together to take on massive bosses. Challenge yourself with increasingly difficult tasks. The First Descendant is available via Xbox, PlayStation, and PC via Steam.

name: Battle Teams 2
description:
Battle Teams 2 is a multiplayer tactical shooter set in an Eastern environment. Developed and published by Wizard Games Global, the game features a selection of PvP modes as well as narrative-driven co-op PvE in which players fight waves of enemies with their friends.

The game includes well-known modes such as Battle Royale and Team Deathmatch as well as more innovative ones like Big Head Hearo and Infected. Players will discover a wide selection of customizable weapons as they play, allowing them to create their own playstyle and build loadouts.

Battle Teams 2 is optimized for PC with five graphics settings ranging from very low to very high. This allows access to more players no matter their current setup.

name: Project Entropy
description:
Project Entropy is a 3d sci-fi MMO strategy game that throws you into a unstable galaxy where civilizations rise, collide, and disappear. As a commander, you don’t just lead a fleet, you shape entire alien societies, each with unique technologies, strengths, and ways of fighting for survival across the stars.

Your journey takes you across unexplored planets and shifting star systems filled with danger, opportunity, and constant conflict. Every world you encounter can be conquered, harvested, or lost to rival commanders competing for control of the same expanding frontier.

Combat is built around deep customization and tactical decision-making. You’ll assemble specialized hero fleets, upgrade advanced mechs, and refine weapon systems to match your strategy, whether that’s overwhelming force, precise strikes, or coordinated multi-layered assaults in PvP and PvE battles.

Beyond warfare, Project Entropy is shaped by alliances, seasonal updates, and a living galaxy that never stays the same for long. Join players worldwide, adapt to ever-changing conditions, and uncover the deeper mystery behind a universe slowly drifting toward chaos.

name: Primordials: Battle of Gods
description:
Build armies and fight for control of the realm in Global Dodo Entertainment’s 1v1 strategy game Primordials: Battle of Gods. Take on the role of a Primordial and create an empire through conquest and the careful management of resources and building. While building their empire, playuers will need to not only upgrade buildings, but also champions and minions, in order to come out on top.
 
Some of these units have special abilities and ultimates that can only be brought out through careful upgrading. Upgrading minions and champions as well as buildings create more options regarding how players approach gameplay, giving them more ways to counter their opponent.  

The game features seven different Primordials for players to choose from. Each has its own lore and related special abilties, each affecting gameplay in a different way and making for a unique game. There are also eight champions, each with its own set of abilities. And, to round things out, three different realms, each with their own races that take on the role of minions.

name: A.V.A Global
description:
A.V.A is a free-to-play online first-person shooter with multiple game modes, unique customizations, as well as PvP and PvE gameplay.

If you are worried about running out of different game modes, customization and maps have no fear, in A.V.A there more than 14 maps, several game modes including Annihilation, Demolition and Breach! Plus the weapon attachment system allows you to modify your own weapons. Pick your favorite class and jump into the action!

name: Blankos Block Party
description:
What happens when you take the vinyl collectible toy experience and combine it with an open-world multiplayer game? You get Blankos Block Party, a free-to-play game that allows players to build their own block parties – which are like Mario Party-style activities – to share with their friends. Players can even participate in regular competitions held by the developer Mythical Games, for a chance to see their builds featured.

In addition to the block party builds, the game’s other focus is on the Blankos, vinyl-style “dolls” brought to life. Just like with real world vinyl dolls, these are collectible and can be bought and sold. Just like with real-world collectables, Blankos Block Party features limited edition vinyls, including some players can win or those that are available as part of seasonal events. The Blankos in question are designed by popular vinyl toy artists like Jon-Paul Kaiser, Tara McPherson, Kronk, and Dan Lish.

name: Sky: Children of the Light
description:
When it comes to games that will make you feel warm and fuzzy, the offerings of thatgamecompany are at the top of the list. The developer of Flower, Flow, and Journey works hard to give players relaxing and comforting games, whether they be single or multiplayer. Sky: Children of the Light is no different. The MMORPG is a social adventure game that takes place throughout seven realms, with players taking on the role of a child using the light within them to heal the world.

Throughout the game, players meet the spirits of their ancestors who are stuck in the world. Using their light, players can free them and send them home to the stars. To do this players explore an open world – flying, swimming, and gliding. They can go it alone, or team up with friends to go on quests, solve puzzles, and more.

Unlike most MMOs, Sky: Children of the Light doesn’t use a regular chat system but encourages players to interact via emotes. Grab a friend’s hand and take them with you.

name: The Division Resurgence
description:
Set in New York City, Ubisoft’s The Division Resurgence is an open-world shooter that can be played alone or in co-op. Explore areas based on the city’s most well-known locations while completing over 100 activities and experiencing the story of a plot threatening the city.

The game offers plenty of variety when it comes to weapons and gear. Players can easily customize them using skins and cosmetics as well. Weapons and gear are obtainable via gameplay (looting and crafting), as are some skins and cosmetics.

In the game’s storyline, players are part of a first wave of SHD agents, choosing a specialization that fits them, complete with signature weapons and gadgets. During this story, they’ll learn more about the events of Division 1 & 2. Players can either experience the story alone or bring along friends in co-op mode.

As for PvP, players can head to a PvPvE area known as the Dark Zone. There, they can compete solo or with a team, earning gear and other rewards as they do.

name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
description:
Explore the world of Britannia with the next generation of heroes and some of your favorite characters in Netmarble’s open-world RPG. The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin follows the story of Prince Tristan of the Kingdom of Liones as he and his friends go on an epic journey to fix the issues caused by temporal distortions. Luckily, they have the help of a device that allows them to reverse time.

The gacha game is based on the popular manga and anime, allowing players to add well-known characters, as well as new ones, to their roster. Build the best team to deal with the world’s various monsters and bosses as you explore the landscape and put things right.

In addition to the hero collecting and combat, the game offers several types of relaxing activities, such as fishing, cooking, and crafting. Players can also uncover hidden dungeons, track down treasure, and just enjoy the journey.

name: 2XKO
description:
Take your favorite League of Legends characters, put them in a 2v2 fighting game, and you'll have 2XKO. The game features a roster of well-known characters from Riot Games' popular IP, such as Jinx, Ahri, Teemo, and Ekko — all with an ability kit inspired by their MOBA counterparts.

The game is built with 2v2 gameplay in mind. As a result, players who want to play in 1v1 matches will find themselves controlling two characters at once. In combat, players use modifiers known as Fuses to enhance gameplay. These are chosen at the beginning of a match and can't be changed once the match is underway.

As with any Riot game, 2XKO features several cosmetics for players. These include skins, emotes, stickers, and more.

name: League of Angels - Heaven's Fury
description:
League of Angels - Heaven’s Fury is a free-to-play, browser-based fantasy online action RPG based loosely on Western mythology. Players in the roles of mages, archers, or dragoons gather “Angels” based on both angels of the Christian faith and gods of pagan pantheons together and return the heavens to their former glory. This is the latest game in a long franchise and features many of the things players have come to expect based on previous titles.

The game’s story begins at the beginning of the universe, when everything is born from Chaos. The Chaos gave birth to the mother of the Earth as well as the gods of Hell, darkness, night, and love. However, what once was came to an end when the king of the gods, Zeus, sought to prevent the prophesied  fall of the gods by opening Pandora’s Box. Upon doing so, he unwittingly corrupted himself and became a slave to demons, causing the world to fall into disarray. Humans and gods all suffered.

The only solution now is for someone pure to bring the holy angels together and save the world.

name: Town of Salem 2
description:
Town of Salem 2 is a free-to-play deception and deduction game set in the town of Salem. Up to fifteen players take on the role of villagers. Each villager has unique abilities to use in the game, whether to confirm their innocence or track down killers. Some players will take on the role of one of three factions: Coven, Neutral, and Apocalypse, and work to stop the town from solving the murders and cleaning up their town.

The game offers custom lobbies so that players may compete with friends. An unusual feature of the game is that players can personalize a lot of things, not just their characters, but also their pets and their house’s interior. Players can also freely move around the game in lobbies, at night, or as a ghost, to fully explore the game world.

When putting together a match, players have control over the kinds of roles that are allowed, as well as game modifiers. In addition, players who have scrolls can boost their chances of getting the role they want. Provided it hasn’t been banned.

name: Once Human
description:
Once Human is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game from Starry Studio in which all living things are infested by an alien creature known as Stardust. Players take on the role of Meta-Humans, able to explore the world without being contaminated. They can also use Stardust to their advantage.

Players will begin their journey in the middle of nowhere. They won’t just have to deal with the living things trying to kill them, but also the land itself. The Stardust has polluted the soil and water and consuming that pollution affects Sanity, causing both it and HP to drop. Still, you gotta eat.

The game features a variety of once-human monsters and interdimensional bosses for players to fight. It offers players customization in the form of approximately 100 gun blueprints divided into seven categories. Players can build their own homes, designing them to their specifications. And, of course, as they play, they’ll discover the truth of Stardust.

name: Splitgate: Arena Reloaded
description:
Portals and guns. What more could you want in your free-to-play team shooter? That’s exactly what 1047 Games’ Splitgate: Arena Reloaded provides. Players utilize the portals in combat, attempting to outmaneuver each other. Portals can be chained, used to dodge attacks, and do any number of other things. The players who develop their skills using the portals will be the ones to come out on top.

The game features three factions, each representatives of one of the planets in our solar system: Earth, Mars, and Venus. There are several modes for players to choose from. Included are: Arena, Team Deathmatch, Onslaught, The Lab, and others. The most recently added mode is Battle Royale.
